records.review: Official university homepage ownership is supported. The university international-domain 2021 留学生招生专业目录 directly lists foreign-student undergraduate programs, Chinese-medium instruction, four-year duration and tuition. This is historical 2021 evidence only. The cited 2026 university page returned 412 and could not be independently read, so it does not prove a current intake. Thai-specific eligibility, current programs, dates and scholarships remain unknown.

Official Chinese Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences page associates Gansu University of Chinese Medicine with an international-education URL. The university notice and provincial PDF could not be opened, while the portal title supports international application use but not a current bachelor's cycle. Keep current intake, Thai eligibility, programs, and scholarship unknown; do not use third-party mirrors or mark no-current.

Independent review found no university-domain original for the mirrored 2025 international-student notice; the 2026/27 cycle is unconfirmed. Preserve the mirror as a lead only; do not accept its program, HSK, deadline, fee or scholarship details as verified.

The official international office page identifies a foreign-student enrollment application form published 2024-04-11, but the form attachment was not reviewed and no named current intake or bachelor's scope is established. Domestic 2026 admissions are separate. Thai eligibility, programs and scholarship unknown.

A third-party reproduction of the 2026 domestic charter lists the candidate university and its homepage/admissions domains, but direct official-domain ownership was not verified. No official foreign-undergraduate source was found. The domestic Gaokao charter and awards are not international admissions evidence.

The homepage candidate times out and is supported only by a third-party domestic admissions charter. A 2021 international-exchange visit is context only, not student recruitment. No primary evidence for foreign bachelor's admissions, portal, programs, scholarship or cycle. A provincial 2024 statistics search snippet reporting zero foreign-student receiving majors was not directly verified and cannot decide another cycle.

Official homepage, 2026 domestic admissions charter and international-relations pages were inspected. They establish identity and domestic admissions/exchange activity only; no foreign undergraduate intake, portal, program, Thai eligibility or scholarship was found. Contact the official office for written confirmation. Do not infer non-admission.

Official homepage ownership and the linked admissions and foreign-affairs subsites are verified. The university's 2026 admissions materials are domestic; foreign-affairs pages cover exchange/foreign-teacher activity, and image-only admissions files were not visually reviewed. No foreign bachelor's notice, current cycle, Thai eligibility, foreign program list or scholarship is established. Request written confirmation from the official offices.

records.review: The official 2021 international-student recruitment notice is historical and expressly describes a three-year junior-college (专科) course, not bachelor's admission. Its 2021 HSK, deadline, route and scholarship claims must not be carried forward. The five 2025 vocational bachelor programs are institution-wide programs and do not establish foreign access. No current foreign bachelor's intake, Thai eligibility, application portal or scholarship is verified.

Official homepage and 2026 admissions pages were inspected and establish domestic provincial routes only. Police-major eligibility expressly requires PRC nationality and the Gansu Gaokao; the separate comprehensive evaluation is also provincial domestic recruitment. These do not answer whether a separate foreign undergraduate path exists. No foreign portal, cycle, Thai eligibility, foreign program list or scholarship is verified.
